title: Basal is On when 0 Basal is registered
symptom: The user got a hypo alert because AAPS/log evidence reported the pump was set to 0 basal while the pump was actually still delivering insulin. The problem started around 17:30 without a known trigger, and a restart did not immediately stop it.
cause: Nightscout (NS) upload only was not enabled, so AAPS was downloading from NS. NS was bouncing back/corrupting treatment data and could create or overwrite current treatments, including a false 0-basal treatment, that did not match what the pump was actually doing.
fix: Set NS to upload only in AndroidAPS; the user did this and it worked. Commenters also recommended completely disabling continuous download from NS and adding a warning, while the maintainer said the issue would be resolved by the new NSClient.
evidence_quote: This is once again a dangerous situation because of NS upload only was not enabled. @smokkelaar now set NS to upload only and it works now.
